name: Love*Love Aloe-ryou e Youkoso!?
original_name: LOVE*LOVEアロエ寮へようこそっ！？
source:
Sanders aims at his tiny classmate in the magical academy. They liked each other as trainees, so now love is in full bloom. Their everyday is full of naughty episodes.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
桑德斯将目标锁定在了魔法学园里身材娇小的同班女同学身上。两人早在见习生时期便互有好感，如今恋情终于全面盛放，每一天都充满了色气满满的甜蜜插曲。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
